name: PRISON FIGHT! 👊
desc:
👊 Welcome to "PRISON FIGHT" where you fight everyone in a prison! Make teams and fight with weapons to earn some respect!

CONTROLS:
PUNCH - CLICK / TAP UI Button
SPIN KICK - Q / TAP UI Button
STOMP - E / TAP UI Button
DANCE - F / TAP UI Button
